## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Testing

- [ ] `go test -race ./...`
- [ ] `go vet ./...`
- [ ] New behavior is covered by tests
- [ ] Documentation is updated where needed

## Safety

- [ ] No credentials, tokens, personal listening data, or generated files are committed
- [ ] Write/authentication tools remain opt-in
- [ ] HTTP security assumptions are documented
